seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: The ABC7 table (updated July 14, 2026) shows Aguilar 54% (64,068) and Vargas 18% (20,952). A voter guide also listed Eugene Weems (R) in the primary. The AP item for Aguilar was undated; the one for Vargas fits 2026. Name form: AP uses Stephanie Vargas, iVoterGuide uses Stephanie M. Vargas; the ballot form is unverified. Aguilar has an official biography at aguilar.house.gov/about/full-biography, but it was not read; offices with dates, education, and birth details are gaps because the web-search budget ran out. Incumbent means the current member for district number 33; Prop 50 redrew the boundaries.
